sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM customers WHERE is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS shanghai_customer_count FROM customers WHERE city = '上海'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products
SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND ordered_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS signup_count FROM customers WHERE signup_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND signup_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'

SELECT substr(ordered_at, 1, 10) AS order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND ordered_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY substr(ordered_at, 1, 10)
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city
SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.list_price_cents) AS avg_list_price_cents FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name

SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers cu JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.full_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, cu.full_name ASC, cu.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT substr(paid_at, 1, 7) AS paid_month, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY substr(paid_at, 1, 7)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) AS captured_cents FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'

WITH captured AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM payments p WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ), returned AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM refunds r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' ) SELECT captured.amount - returned.amount AS net_receipts_cents FROM captured CROSS JOIN returned
SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.full_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers cu LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.full_name

SELECT c.category_name, COALESCE(m.amount, 0) AS merchandise_cents FROM categories c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - oi.discount_cents) AS amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY p.category_id ) m ON m.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT cu.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cu.city ORDER BY order_count DESC, cu.city ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.full_name FROM customers cu WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = cu.customer_id)
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id)

WITH captured AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' AND c.city = '上海' ), returned AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' AND c.city = '上海' ) SELECT captured.amount - returned.amount AS net_receipts_cents FROM captured CROSS JOIN returned

WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY c.city ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) AS captured_cents FROM (SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers) AS cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.full_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id WHERE r.status = 'completed'
SELECT o.order_id, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS captured_cents FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT p.payment_id, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.payment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunded_cents FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY refunded_cents DESC, c.full_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 5

WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), returned AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), cities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) - COALESCE(returned.amount, 0) AS net_receipts_cents FROM cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.city = cities.city ORDER BY net_receipts_cents DESC, cities.city ASC LIMIT 5

WITH sep AS ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) AS net_receipts_cents ), oct AS ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) AS net_receipts_cents ) SELECT '2026-09' AS month, net_receipts_cents FROM sep UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10' AS month, net_receipts_cents FROM oct

WITH sep AS ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) AS net_receipts_cents ), oct AS ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'), 0) AS net_receipts_cents ) SELECT oct.net_receipts_cents - sep.net_receipts_cents AS growth_cents FROM sep CROSS JOIN oct

WITH sep AS ( SELECT city, net_receipts_cents FROM (WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), returned AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), cities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) - COALESCE(returned.amount, 0) AS net_receipts_cents FROM cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.city = cities.city) ), oct AS ( SELECT city, net_receipts_cents FROM (WITH captured AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS amount FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), returned AS ( SELECT c.city AS city, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS amount FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.city ), cities AS ( SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ) SELECT cities.city, COALESCE(captured.amount, 0) - COALESCE(returned.amount, 0) AS net_receipts_cents FROM cities LEFT JOIN captured ON captured.city = cities.city LEFT JOIN returned ON returned.city = cities.city) ) SELECT oct.city, oct.net_receipts_cents - sep.net_receipts_cents AS net_change_cents FROM oct JOIN sep ON sep.city = oct.city

SELECT c.city, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS paid_order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.status = 'succeeded' ) GROUP BY c.city
SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_email_count FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpaid_order_count FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.status = 'succeeded' )

WITH partial_orders AS ( SELECT p.order_id FROM payments p JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id AND r.status = 'completed' WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY p.order_id HAVING SUM(r.amount_cents) > 0 AND SUM(r.amount_cents) < ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p2.amount_cents), 0) FROM payments p2 WHERE p2.order_id = p.order_id AND p2.status = 'succeeded' ) ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS partial_refund_order_count FROM partial_orders

WITH pay AS ( SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS captured FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id ), ref AS ( SELECT p.order_id AS order_id, SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refunded FROM refunds r JOIN payments p ON p.payment_id = r.payment_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.order_id ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS full_refund_order_count FROM pay JOIN ref ON ref.order_id = pay.order_id WHERE pay.captured > 0 AND ref.refunded = pay.captured
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_cents), 0) AS captured_cents FROM payments WHERE status = 'succeeded' AND paid_at >= '2026-12-01T00:00:00Z' AND paid_at < '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z'

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND p.status = 'succeeded' )
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price_cents != p.list_price_cents

SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name, SUM(p.amount_cents) AS captured_cents FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND p.paid_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' AND p.paid_at < '2026-11-01T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY captured_cents DESC, c.full_name ASC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1
